text: Sick with glandular fever, eleven-year-old Anna Madden draws a house, and each time she falls asleep [she finds herself inside it|rules|reality comes apart]. She draws a face at the window and meets Marc, a real boy with muscular dystrophy, living there, and every addition, from stairs to a fruit tree, appears in the dream. When she sketches her absent, drinking father with an angry face, he [returns as a furious, blinded figure|images|ghosts and strange figures], while in the waking world [Marc is dying|who_suffers|the old, sick and dying].
